history.summary: The Shri Venkateshwara Devasthanam at 301 Akkalkot Road, Bhadravathi Peth (Daji Peth), Jodbasavanna Chowk, Solapur, is a modern Vishnu temple built in the South Indian style and modelled closely on the Tirupati Tirumala Devasthanam - reviewers note the prasad, rituals and even the hand-painted interiors echo Tirumala. The presiding deity is Lord Venkateshwara (Govinda), with shrines to Padmavati and Kartik Swami in the complex. The temple keeps cows in a goshala that visitors may feed with the trust's permission, serves Tirupati-style laddu prasad, and performs Tulsi Archana, Pushpa Archana and Neej aarti. It also provides advance-booking assistance for Tirumala/Tirupati darshan tickets and rooms. No source found gives the temple's founding year - several reviews call it 'very old' but without dates (verify).

name: Shri Venkateshwara Devasthanam
town_description: Solapur is a city and municipal corporation in south-eastern Maharashtra, near the Karnataka border, and the administrative headquarters of Solapur district. It is a melting pot of Marathi, Telugu and Kannada cultures, a major railway junction on the north-south line, and a textile centre famous for Solapuri chaddars (bed-sheets). Pilgrim centres nearby include Pandharpur (Vithoba) and Akkalkot (Swami Samarth).

travel.airport: Solapur Airport is the nearest airport (approx. 8-12 km from Jodbasavanna Chowk; verify - limited services). Pune International Airport is approx. 235-250 km.
travel.railway: Solapur Junction is the nearest major railway station (approx. 1-2 km from the temple; verify), well connected to Mumbai, Pune and Hyderabad.
travel.road: Located on Akkalkot Road (NH-65 corridor) in central Solapur at Jodbasavanna Chowk; city autos and buses serve the area. The temple offers parking facilities.

visitor_information.best_time: October to February for pleasant weather; Vaikuntha Ekadashi, Dhanurmaas and Brahmotsav festival days are the most devotional times to visit (verify exact dates).
visitor_information.opening_hours: CONFLICT (verify): Justdial lists 9:00 AM-5:00 PM; 5BestInCity lists 8:00 AM-12:00 PM & 5:00-8:00 PM; one directory listing shows 8:00 AM-8:00 PM. Photography is reported as allowed; prasad is available.
